_comment: NFR-P1 performance budget for the admin workspace shell (TP1-07, P1-12). check-lighthouse.mjs runs Lighthouse against each page and fails if the budget is breached. NFR-P1: the shell loads and is interactive in 2.5s or less (LCP) on a mid-range laptop on broadband, so the budget is desktop form factor, LCP <= 2500ms. The shell demo is gated off in a normal prod build, so build + start with NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_GALLERY=1 before running. Add real admin screens here as they land in later tickets.
